title: Junior Compliance Counsel
desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Role

As an Insurance Compliance Counsel at Alan, you will help Alan meet its insurance compliance and consumer protection obligations. You will work with the teammates who build our tools, processes and products to turn regulatory requirements into how they actually work. Working closely with senior members of the compliance team, you will run key parts of our compliance work day to day, flag risks early, and prepare the material we share with regulators on the topics you cover.

You will also help connect the compliance function with internal control and Alan’s audit processes. That means tracking audit findings, following remediation through to completion, and making sure the fixes become part of how we operate.

As Alan expands into new markets, you will help our compliance standards travel with us by adapting Group frameworks to local requirements, working with local counsel.

The role sits withinthe Corporate Unit. You will work closely every day with the Legal, Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care and Product teammates across all of Alan’s markets. It’s a great opportunity to build broad compliance expertise and take on more ownership over time.

What You Will Do

Contribute to Alan’s Insurance Compliance Posture

 - Help translate regulatory obligations relating to Alan’s core product (IDD including duty of advice, product governance, AML/CFT, etc.) into Alan’s operational processes, product design and tooling

 - Work with Product, Insurance and Care teams to find ways to meet regulatory requirements while improving members’ experience, from pricing components and options design to UX choices and complaint handling

 - Spot compliance risks in your day-to-day work, document them, and contribute to action plans with internal stakeholders

 - Run the complaints management framework day to day across France, Belgium and Spain: monitor complaints, analyse trends and propose improvements in line with ACPR recommendations and local equivalents

Reporting & Audits

 - Document compliance-related risks and controls in the Group’s centralised mapping, and support the rollout of the internal control approach across teams (Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care)

 - Help prepare internal and external audits: gather evidence, check Alan’s standing against planned improvements, and track remediation actions through to completion

 - Prepare inputs for compliance reporting to Alan’s Board and governance committees, and contribute to regulatory reporting such as the ACPR Questionnaire Protection de la Clientèle (QPC)

 - Support responses to regulatory inspections (ACPR, FSMA or equivalent) by collecting information internally and keeping documentation audit-ready

AML/CFT & KYC

 - Support the AML framework: carry out second-level analysis on suspicious cases, prepare files for escalation (including PEPs and high-risk client relationships), and help keep the AML/CFT risk assessment up to date

 - Contribute to the training and upskilling of KYC Ops referents, including on Belgium-specific AML requirements

 - Assist the AMLO on documentation, monitoring tools and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

 - Track progress on Alan’s compliance roadmap and flag changes in the regulatory environment that may affect priorities

 - Drive well-scoped compliance projects with Insurance, Product, Sales, Care and Operations, turning regulatory requirements into concrete deliverables and timelines

 - Research regulatory questions affecting our products and contracts, and propose pragmatic, well-reasoned positions for review

Regulatory Training & Internal Capability

 - Help design, update and deliver mandatory regulatory training for Sales and Care roles (IDD competency requirements including duty of advice and product governance, Loi Evin, AML/CFT)

 - Write guidelines, templates and decision-making tools that help teams handle compliance questions autonomously

 - Contribute to Alan’s written culture by producing clear, reliable documentation

International Compliance & Localisation

 - Support the adaptation of Group compliance frameworks to local requirements in Alan’s markets (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada and new countries), working with local counsel

Profile

Experience & Skills

 - 2+ years of experience in compliance, ideally in an insurance or fintech company (a regulator, audit or consulting background also works); exposure to at least one of: AML/CFT, insurance distribution (IDD), complaints handling, regulatory reporting

 - Good understanding of the French insurance regulatory framework, and curiosity to learn EU and local requirements

 - Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders: you can explain regulatory requirements clearly and turn them into practical next steps…

title: User Research UX Apprentice
desc:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The User Research team’s mission is to help everybody at Back Market get to know and love our users  so that we can create great experiences for them. We gather insights about what users need through a range of qualitative and quantitative techniques and translate them into valuable information for the product and design team.

As an User Research (UX) Apprentice, you will work on the e-commerce experience Back Market provides to its customers, using insights to provide actionable recommendations for improvements, as well as contributing to improve our research processes, tools, and communications. You will also work closely with our business and product teams to ensure a user -centered culture in our problem and solution definition.




YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

 - Bring stakeholders (business people), designers, product owners and engineers together to build, maintain, and evolve a robust experience for Back Market’s customers

 - Listen to business problems and helping craft action plans

 - Conduct qualitative research to collect insights and build strong recommendations

 - Launch quantitative studies to discover trends and validate the hypothesis

 - Work closely with product designers to ensure that your recommendations have the maximum impact

 - Present the results of your work to the company and make sure that the value of research is understood

 - Contribute to the development of the UX Research team with your colleagues




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

 - You're looking for an apprenticeship

 - English is a no-brainer (fully professional capability) for you. If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

 - You have experience or convincing knowledge of best practices in conducting research (qualitative and quantitative research methods, such as usability testing, observational research, user interviews, surveys, card sorts, contextual inquiry, etc.)

 - You have strong presentation and communication skills.

 - You have e-commerce experience, that would be a plus but it's not required.




ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIPℹ️

 - Starting date: January 2027

 - Duration: Ideally for 24 months (12 months to be discussed).

 - Location: Bordeaux, France

 - Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)




RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

 - Skills fit/Tech interview with the direct manager

 - Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

 - Video-call Interview with the Campus Talent Acquisition Specialist




WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.
